neighbours.label: pencils, drafting leads and similar fine tools for drawing or writing ('mechanical pencils or drafting leads', 'pencil grips')
fire: My sister draws with charcoal sticks or drafting pencils.
Rubber or foam pencil grips can help young writers.
Illustrators often use technical pens and fine brushes.
A mechanical pencil or a drafting lead gives thin lines.
Sharpen your colored pencils before you begin the sketch.
The kit holds a ruler, an eraser and a drafting pen.
Some cartoonists swear by a fine-tip marker or pencil.
Thick pencils or ink pens are sold at the art shop.
quiet: My sister paints with big rollers on large walls.
Rubber or foam floor mats can help tired workers.
Bakers often use wooden spoons and deep bowls.
A garden hose or a watering can gives enough water.
Sharpen your kitchen knives before you begin the roast.
The kit holds a hammer, a saw and a box of nails.
Some gardeners swear by a sharp spade or rake.
Warm mittens or wool scarves are sold at the market.
